source_files: gm2_model_v2.py (make_base_params, FUSEvent class, DEFAULT_FUS_EVENTS, fus_multiplier, drift_full k_entry_eff term)
sobol_driver_v2.py (PARAM_NAMES / BASELINES -- fus_entry_gain_scale appears as a swept Sobol parameter, baseline value taken from make_base_params)
factorial_arms_shapley.py (uses DEFAULT_FUS_EVENTS unmodified for the FUS arm of the 8-arm factorial that produced factorial_arms_shapley*.json)
note_on_model_scope: gm2_model_v2.py's FUS representation is purely phenomenological: a smoothed top-hat 'gain multiplier' m_FUS(t) applied multiplicatively to two rate constants (k_p2b -> SRT brain uptake, via fus_uptake_gain_scale; k_T4_entry -> AAV-T4 BBB entry, via fus_entry_gain_scale). There is no acoustic/biophysical submodel anywhere in this project's Sobol pipeline (gm2_model_v2.py, gm2_solver.py, sobol_driver*.py, factorial_arms_shapley.py) -- no pressure field, no MI formula, no microbubble concentration/dose state or parameter. (A biophysical FUS/microbubble model -- lifu_acoustic.py -- exists in a SEPARATE project, ~/lifu_gm2_250k/, which trains a neural-network surrogate for a different purpose; it is not wired into gm2_model_v2.py or any Sobol/factorial run in gm2_sobol/, so its parameters are out of scope here and would misrepresent this model if reported as 'the' FUS protocol.)

peak_negative_pressure_mpa.reason: Not modeled. gm2_model_v2.py's FUS term is a dimensionless multiplicative gain envelope (FUSEvent.gain, unitless), not an acoustic pressure field. No MPa-valued parameter exists anywhere in gm2_model_v2.py, gm2_solver.py, or the Sobol drivers.

mechanical_index.reason: Not modeled, for the same reason as peak negative pressure -- MI = PNP/sqrt(f_center) requires a pressure and a frequency, neither of which appears in this model.

microbubble_dose.reason: Not modeled. No microbubble compartment, concentration, or dose parameter exists in gm2_model_v2.py's state vector or parameter dict; BBB-opening effect is represented directly as the FUS gain multiplier, with no upstream microbubble mechanism.

first_sonication_day.source: gm2_model_v2.py DEFAULT_FUS_EVENTS[0].day = 30.0 (also coincides with t4_admin_day=30.0, the AAV-T4 administration day, in run_single()/factorial_arms_shapley.py's run_arm())

session_duration.source: gm2_model_v2.py FUSEvent.duration_hours, all 3 sessions use duration_hours=1.0 (i.e. [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]); each event's multiplier envelope additionally has smooth_tau_hours=0.5 (default) controlling Gaussian edge-smoothing, not the nominal duration itself

inter_session_spacing_days.source: Computed from DEFAULT_FUS_EVENTS day values ([30.0, 60.0, 90.0]): evenly spaced at 30 days (day 30 -> 60 -> 90)

fus_entry_gain_scale.source: gm2_model_v2.py make_base_params(): 'fus_entry_gain_scale': 1.5 (baseline/default value). This is the actual numeric setting used to run the default/factorial model (run_single(), factorial_arms_shapley.py) -- distinct from its ROLE as a swept Sobol parameter in sobol_driver_v2.PARAM_NAMES, where it is varied within a prior interval (see parameter_provenance.json) rather than held fixed at 1.5.
fus_entry_gain_scale.mechanistic_role: k_T4_entry_effective = k_T4_entry * (1 + fus_entry_gain_scale * (m_FUS(t) - 1)) * immune_suppression -- i.e. it scales how much the FUS gain envelope (m_FUS - 1, which peaks per-event at FUSEvent.gain) boosts the baseline BBB entry rate k_T4_entry.

related_but_distinct_parameter.note: Separate gain-scale parameter (baseline 1.0) that scales the FUS envelope's effect on SRT brain uptake (k_p2b), not AAV-T4 entry. Not asked for explicitly but included since it is easily confused with fus_entry_gain_scale.

per_event_gain_is_a_different_parameter.note: Each of the 3 sessions has its OWN 'gain' (day30: 1.8, day60: 1.6, day90: 1.5) that shapes the peak height of that session's contribution to m_FUS(t). This is NOT the same number as fus_entry_gain_scale (1.5, a single global sensitivity coefficient) even though the day-90 session's gain (1.5) happens to numerically coincide with fus_entry_gain_scale's baseline value.
